cc:Work.dc:title: figure1_task_relevant_acquisition_framework
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 1. Task-Relevant Information Acquisition. Part I characterizes spatial, sparse, objective-conditioned, and state-conditioned task information. Part II estimates value from legal partial state and realizes measurement sets under exact native-raster cost. Retrospective teachers and oracles characterize value; the acquisition rule uses only legal state.
